notes.title: Adventure hotfix is live
notes.notes:
The adventure hotfix is live. 

To receive your missing items, please:

1. Open the event Bank

2. You should see a new "Compensation" tab, where you can get the missing items and adventure EXP

Some of your items may become fake. This is unintended and will be fixed separately

If you have any remaining issues, please create a ticket in our support channel in Discord

Hello, @everyone! 



Currently we are working on implementing hotfixes for the issue that causes loss of progress in the active adventure event. You will also be able to claim missed items and progression exp in a new bank tab. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: A temporary solution to frequent crashes in Steam version of the game
notes.notes:
Hello! Since the issue is widespread, we decided that announcement was needed so that as many people as possible could know what to try.

We are aware of this problem and our team is working on a permanent solution as a priority task. For now, there is a temporary measure that can help you: 
1) Turn off the game
2) Click with the right mouse button on the Horny Villa in your Steam library.
3) Select "Properties..."
4) You will immediately see a text box. Copy and paste parameters "-force-glcore" without quotation marks.

notes.title: Event crash hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello! A hotfix for the newest event's crashes on the Steam version of Villa is rolled out. If you encountered the problem, please fully reload your game and check if the event works properly

Thank you for your understanding and continuous support!

notes.title: 🛠️ Update Notes – March 28, 2025 🛠️
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011157/0f386d181e528b06396668d9c3ed7dcf3950f685.jpg

🛠️ Update Notes – March 28, 2025 🛠️

Hey Horny Villa players! Ready for new adventures? You better be, because the second half of the Fifth Room is finally here! We know you’ve been craving more, and now it’s time to dive into all that fresh, naughty content! 😈💋

We’ve also tested a few balance changes recently, and thanks to your feedback, we’re making things better than ever. Here’s what’s new:

💰 Selling prices for items are back (yes, we heard you loud and clear!)
🏦 Increased resource gains from Bank purchases
💎 Higher rewards in coins and gems
🛏️ Lost your girls? Debbie, Bunny, and Iris have moved to the Fifth Room — check under the bed, just in case!

Thank you so much for your incredible support and feedback. Together, we’re making Horny Villa even hotter! 🔥

notes.title: 🔥 Battle Pass Update – Play & Earn! 🔥
notes.notes:
We’re making changes to the Battle Pass progression to make it more engaging! Instead of relying on a single generator, you'll now earn Battle Pass points through active gameplay—completing event tasks and playing consistently throughout the season.

🔹 What does this mean for you?
✅ Active players will now progress naturally just by playing!
✅ Free-to-play players can complete up to 90% of the Battle Pass with regular play.
✅ No more grinding one generator—your effort across events will be rewarded!

We believe the Battle Pass should reward playing the game, not just idling in one spot. This is a big step towards making progression more fun for everyone!

🏆 Get ready to claim those rewards—this season will be worth it! 😈

notes.title: 📢 UPDATE ON SUBSCRIPTION ISSUE & COMPENSATION 📢
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011157/865773606551f4dc005da2dde79b233a25f7f256.png
We’re aware of a technical issue that unintentionally affected players who purchased a subscription before recent adjustments. Those who subscribed earlier should have received the original rewards in full, and we sincerely apologize for the mistake.

We will provide compensation to all affected players within this or next week. If you haven’t received it after that period, please contact our discord support.

Thank you for your patience and support! 💙
